entries.title: Fixed Open Resonator and Descending Coil Thunder Drum Display
entries.description: One newly authored complete spring-drum-inspired fixed display. A full tall thick tubular resonator has a genuine open upper mouth and one whole finite lower membrane. A single continuous capped twelve-turn metal-look helix attaches beneath that membrane and descends externally to a free blunt lower end, with visible inter-turn air and ample ground clearance. One complete connected wooden-look display cradle integrates a broad flat foot, two slim uprights and inward shoulders that seat in opposite outer shell walls. A whole annular upper rim leaves the mouth open. The external free spring, opposite open chamber and raised shell support relation differs from the old tilted cuica with an internal straight rod, six tension rods and lower mouth; it is not an inclined soldering rest holding a parked tool. Every visible numeric geometry is newly authored, no prior shell, helix, foot or brace mesh imported. Five whole closed editable bodies, four opaque constant PBR roles, metres native Z up and whole horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin. One complete instrument display model zero scenes; cradle and spring are not separate counted assets. Plain generic category inspiration only, no brand graphics, copied product dimensions or historical reconstruction. Coarse pitch and thick membrane are deliberate static visual simplifications. No sound, resonance, spring stiffness, oscillation, deflection, membrane tension, acoustic accuracy, physical equilibrium, load, fabrication, handling or safety capability made or verified. No rigging, animation or interaction.
